data.case_title: Usage ban (Nutzungsuntersagung) for basement room at Lennestraße 41
data.summary: The city of Beispielhagen (Fachbereich Bauordnung) issued a decision dated 18 November 2026 prohibiting Ilka Musterlenne from renting out the basement room at Lennestraße 41 as living space, because it lacks sufficient windows and a second escape route. A court action (Klage) against this decision can be filed with the Verwaltungsgericht Musterarnsberg within one month of notification; no preliminary objection (Widerspruch) procedure applies.
data.explanation: The building authority (Bauordnungsamt) has decided that the basement room in your house may not be used as a dwelling because it does not meet safety standards (not enough windows, no second escape route). You must stop renting it out as living space. If you disagree with this decision, you may go straight to court (Klage) at the Verwaltungsgericht Musterarnsberg — there is no Widerspruch step first. The app will show the deadline for filing by the deadline shown. If you take no action in time, the ban becomes final and you remain obligated to stop using the room as housing. Consulting a lawyer specialising in building law (Baurecht) may help if you want to contest this.
